---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve? Describe the frustration or gap.

## Proposed Solution

How would you like this to work?

## Alternatives Considered

Have you tried any workarounds? Are there other approaches?

## Integration Details (if applicable)

- Deployment: local/self-hosted, hosted service, or both?
- Source/license and pricing links:
- What data leaves the server, and for which purpose?
- How are users/projects isolated?
- Are writes opt-in, and can users inspect, export, and delete stored data?
- Can the feature be disabled without breaking existing workflows?

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar features in other tools, etc.
